source.workflow: Targeted sweep · inline IDs · enable=none · disable=none

semantics.candidateObservation: a success-bearing row/artifact presented to this ingestion boundary
semantics.eligibleObservation: a candidate with enough identity/path information to undergo canonical referee/merge handling
semantics.refereeAcceptedObservation: an eligible observation whose exact path is valid against the target level revision
semantics.acceptedAlreadyRepresented: referee-valid observation that produced no semantic store change
semantics.semanticRecordChange: coarse producer-observed change when the current mutation API cannot distinguish path/event/occurrence units
semantics.nullAdditionUnit: this producer cannot measure that addition unit exactly; null is unknown/not-observed, never zero
semantics.notes: direct transported canonical-hint compatibility importer; detailed semantic additions are measured by before/after canonical merge state per referee-accepted observation
